description: This source file implements a finite state machine (FSM) for managing Wi-Fi radio and access point configurations, including start/stop operations, configuration reloading, channel setting, and MLO (Multi-Link Operation) support. It includes functions for enabling/disabling radios and VAPs, handling hostapd interactions, managing MLO links, and synchronizing connection states with remote endpoints, primarily for wireless network management.
